description: Employees ask for days off and managers approve or reject the requests.

fields.name: days
fields.description: calendar days from start_date to end_date, both included

endpoints.summary: Leave days: {"employee_id": int, "annual_days": int, "used_days": int, "pending_days": int, "remaining_days": int}

rules: annual_days cannot be negative; reject with 422.
end_date cannot be before start_date, and start_date cannot be in the past; otherwise reject with 422.
A new leave has status pending. days is the number of calendar days from start_date to end_date, both included (the same date for both is 1 day).
An employee's remaining days are annual_days minus the days of their approved leaves. Asking for more days than remain returns 409.
An employee cannot have two leaves with status pending or approved that share a date; reject with 409.

approve moves a leave from pending to approved; if its days are more than the employee's remaining days at that moment, it returns 409 and the leave stays pending. reject moves a leave from pending to rejected. cancel moves a leave from pending or approved to cancelled. Any other status change returns 409.

GET /employees/{id}/balance returns a JSON object with employee_id, annual_days, used_days (days of approved leaves), pending_days (days of pending leaves) and remaining_days (annual_days minus used_days). An unknown employee returns 404.
employee_id must refer to an existing employee; otherwise 404.
